name: scan-eye
useCase: Identify an eye-scan authentication option beside its label.
misuse: Do not use the eye scan for generic visibility controls or as confirmation that someone has been authenticated.

16.reason: A clear centered pupil stays inside the full eye and four scan corners.

24.reason: The wider eye has a separately tuned opening with at least 1.5px around the pupil and clear space to the scan corners.
